opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed. Board of Trade v. United States, 314 U. S. 534; Virginian R. Co. v. United States, 272 U. S. 658; Central R. Co. v. United States, 257 U. S. 247.
